Round 343 (c4-ii) is in and every A row passed. Nothing stopped me. C still has to run the browser rows before this counts as done.

Dragging two or more selected clips now previews through the preview store instead of the provider's history. The provider and the whole workspace no longer re-render on every pointer move. A group that contains a video clip keeps the old history path; that is stage c5. I applied B's three patches unchanged.

The slowest test in the two changed test files takes 359 ms, far under its timeout.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent found nothing Critical, High or Medium. I left its six Low findings unfixed and listed them for B as A-R343-REVIEW-* ids, because the test changes are B's sketch, which C checks by reversing the patches. The one worth knowing: during a group drag, anything that reads the committed arrangement stays still until release. The reviewer checked the collapsed group header; other multi-selection displays were not checked. C's group-move and overview-follows browser rows cover what the user sees. The reviewer also left an architecture note for B (not acted on): after c5, one small task could remove the video fallback.

**Still open:** I ran no browser rows. Group behaviour, overview-follows, the blocked-move status line and the auth check are C's, and the full test suite and `npm run verify` belong to the gate. I did not touch or restart the :5173 server, and I made no commits.

The full report, including the exact next checks for C, is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-343.md`.
